name: Godot WebXR Kit
authors_metadata: Existing plugin author credit: OSE. Original source and third-party credits are preserved.
license_notes: The source repository has no root license declaration. See LICENSE-NOTICE.md; bundled third-party notices retain their own terms.

compatibility.standard_godot: Uses standard Godot XR/GDScript APIs; official 4.7.1 is the compatibility test baseline.
compatibility.custom_engine: Optional WebGPU path requires matching custom editor and templates.
compatibility.web: WebXR-capable browser, secure context and user gesture; permissions/features are runtime-negotiated.
compatibility.threads: Both supported; threaded web requires COOP/COEP and SharedArrayBuffer. Single-threaded does not require SharedArrayBuffer.
